text:
oliver: quick design check 0m: modal confirm + toast ordering on Deploys page. When you confirm a rollout we show a modal, then a toast saying "Rollout started". On small screens the toast appears under the modal shadow and is hard to notice.

jen: curious 0m: is the toast intentionally below? I thought toasts are global and on top.

maya: repro: mobile width 375, open Deploys, click Rollout, confirm. modal shows, then toast displays bottom-center but z-index is lower than .modal-backdrop.

chris: seems like our backdrop is using z-index: 600 and modal at 610, toasts at 580. probably a token ordering issue.

aria: UX question: should the toast appear while modal remains open? maybe we should close modal on success then show toast, or show inline progress inside modal instead.

oliver: good point. For long-running rollouts modal with inline status feels better. Toasts are for quick ephemeral notices.

jen: inline status would also help screenreader users get a clear update inside the focused context.

maya: proto idea: keep modal open, replace confirm content with progress spinner + "Rollout started" message and hide toast entirely for that flow.

chris: implementation-wise easier: increase toast z-index to 700 so it's visually above modal, but that might feel odd if modal is meant to be the focus.

aria: +1 for inline progress. we should avoid fighting stacking contexts for primary flows. reserve top-level toasts for background events.

jen: also copy nit: current button says "Start rollout" and toast says "Rollout started". feels repetitive. maybe toast: "Rollout queued — check status tab."

oliver: yes change makes sense. small copy: "Rollout queued. View status in Deploys > Activity."

maya: storybook ask: can we add a variant story: modal-confirm -> success-inline (with keyboard flow). I'll add a11y notes about focus management (keep focus in modal, announce status).

chris: dev note: will add a dedicated token group for layered components: tokens.zIndex.modal=610, tokens.zIndex.backdrop=600, tokens.zIndex.toast=580. For special cases we can raise toast but prefer component-level UX changes.

aria: also spotted margin inconsistency: modal footer buttons sit 20px from edge on desktop but 12px in mobile. tokens.spacing.card vs spacing.modalFooter mismatch. suggest using spacing.modalPadding token.

jen: agree. will consolidate token usage. small doc change in design tokens board.

design-bot: design/changes checklist created: D-3721. Assigned: maya (storybook), chris (implementation), jen (copy + tokens). Due: 2026-04-02.

oliver: thanks team. action items: maya add story, chris prototype inline success, jen update tokens + copy. we'll review next sync. :raised_hands:
